metadata.question: Was the total rainfall in Grafton, New South Wales, greater than the total rainfall in Canberra from January 15, 2020 to January 21, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: I’ll use the Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) "NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_MONTHLY" collection, which is daily IMERG Final. Filter date 2020-01-15 to 2020-01-21. I sample the Point for both Canberra and Grafton with ee.Reducer.sum() to obtain total mm over the week. 2. Masking: IMERG rainfall data are not cloud-masked like optical images — just take “precipitationCal” band. 3. Logic: If any collection size is 0 (C1). After reduction, if valid-pixel count is 0 we are C2. If sum is None/NaN or outside physical range (≥0) we are C3. Else compare numbers; if Grafton > Canberra we print A, otherwise B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions grafton = ee.Geometry.Point(152.936, -29.69) # Grafton, NSW canberra = ee.Geometry.Point(149.13, -35.28) # Canberra, ACT t0, t1 = '2020-01-15', '2020-01-21' # 2. Data Acquisition & Check col = (ee.ImageCollection("NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_MONTHLY") .select('precipitationCal') .filterDate(t0, t1)) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("C1: No images in date window.") print("C1") # 3. Processing graft_img = col.sum() countG = graft_img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=grafton, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9) \ .get('precipitationCal').getInfo() countC = graft_img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=canberra, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9) \ .get('precipitationCal').getInfo() if countG == 0 or countC == 0: print("C2: No valid pixels at one or both points.") print("C2") # 4. Calculation sumG = graft_img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=grafton, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9) \ .get('precipitationCal').getInfo() sumC = graft_img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=canberra, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9) \ .get('precipitationCal').getInfo() if sumG is None or sumC is None: print("C3: Calculation returned None.") print("C3") # 5. Validation & Final Answer print(f"Grafton total: {sumG:.1f} mm, Canberra total: {sumC:.1f} mm") if sumG > sumC: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
grafton = ee.Geometry.Point(152.936, -29.69)  # Grafton, NSW
canberra = ee.Geometry.Point(149.13, -35.28)  # Canberra, ACT
t0, t1 = '2020-01-15', '2020-01-21'

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
col = (ee.ImageCollection("NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_MONTHLY")
       .select('precipitationCal')
       .filterDate(t0, t1))
if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("C1: No images in date window.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# 3. Processing
graft_img = col.sum()
countG = graft_img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                                geometry=grafton, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9) \
                   .get('precipitationCal').getInfo()
countC = graft_img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                                geometry=canberra, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9) \
                   .get('precipitationCal').getInfo()
if countG == 0 or countC == 0:
    print("C2: No valid pixels at one or both points.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")

# 4. Calculation
sumG = graft_img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                              geometry=grafton, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9) \
                .get('precipitationCal').getInfo()
sumC = graft_img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                              geometry=canberra, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9) \
                .get('precipitationCal').getInfo()
if sumG is None or sumC is None:
    print("C3: Calculation returned None.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")

# 5. Validation & Final Answer
print(f"Grafton total: {sumG:.1f} mm, Canberra total: {sumC:.1f} mm")
if sumG > sumC:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
